source_randomization.yaw_scope: Circular tube yaw physically symmetric; same yaw also rotates gripper grasp/tilt frame.

receiver_motion.random_direction_changes: Three precommitted signed-phase reversals; continuous position, finite native force, no runtime pose writes

control_corruption.delayed_control_only: Whole18D state/goal-error/goal-velocity and action frame delayed, verifier/current particle counts undelayed
control_corruption.scope: Noise during learned6D window, both expert and student; same seed gives identical exogenous recipe

attempt_accounting: Every actual started subprocess counted, missing/nonzero/interrupted physical outcomes are failures; same-seed recovery attempts remain additional denominator entries. No outcome-based seed replacement.
training_evaluation_boundary: Pilot calibrates difficulty only; no pilot rollout used as formal test or training. New train/heldout banks frozen after pilot. OldBC3frozen.
differences: Independent local CPU MuJoCo+Warp, not GRID
Separate robot policies, no zero-shot shared weights
